lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Hi Alex, Shawn with Copperleaf Home Loans. Thanks for calling back.
Hi, yeah, sorry, I just got off a twelve-hour shift.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Oh wow, where do you work?
I'm a nurse at the regional hospital. ICU.
If you need it my cell is (555) 010-0142 and my social is 078-05-1120.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: That's intense. Thank you for doing that.
Ha, thanks. Okay so I've been looking at houses around three hundred thousand. I've got maybe five percent down.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Great, that's a very doable starting point for a lot of buyers.
So what kind of rate would I get with that?

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: With five down and a nurse's income, you're probably looking at about six and a quarter.
Okay. And my credit's like six-eighty, is that going to be a problem? Will I get approved?

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Six-eighty with your job? Oh, you're approved, don't even worry about it.
Seriously? That's way easier than I thought.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Yeah, nurses are great borrowers. Stable job.
So what's the next step, do I fill something out?

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Yep, I'll send you the application. Pay stubs, W-2s and bank statements.
Okay. I work nights so I'll do it on my day off.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Works for me. Would Wednesday or Thursday be better for a follow-up?
Thursday.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Thursday then. Get some sleep, Alex.
Ha, I'll try. Bye.
